designationHistory.name: Necedah Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established March 14, 1939, as the Necedah Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8065, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

review.note: Parser grabbed a timeline line about the 1939 merger of the Biological Survey and Bureau of Fisheries; the year matches only by chance. Real act: EO 8065.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established as a refuge for breeding and migratory birds and other wildlife while being an inviolate sanctuary for migratory birds. 1939 - The Bureau of Biological Survey from the Department of Agriculture and the Bureau of Fisheries from the Department of Commerce were transferred to the Department of the Interior and became the U.S.
